transfer_scope: CAL-selected best checkpoints, not epoch240. Repaired/damaged counts and probability margins are descriptive, not causal teacher-transfer effects.
diagnostic_scope: Dependence fields are each epoch final FIT batch; gradient fields are first FIT batch. Ten probes do not represent full-dataset distributions or establish gradient conflict/saturation.

cost.prior_gate_failure: CPU input / CUDA model in dimension probe; zero optimizer steps. Separate gate wrapper repaired before training admission.
cost.limitations: Receipt timers exclude unmeasured scheduler/startup overhead; gate elapsed times unavailable. This is not total allocated research GPU time. Different nodes/models prevent a causal speed comparison.

limitations: All are CAL development results, no TEST access.
Short-pilot lambdas may not be optimal for240epochs; conclusion is conditional on these frozen choices.
New long seeds differ from the short seed; short-vs-long does not isolate duration from seed or schedule.
Three seeds do not justify treating a small difference as a proven advantage.
Same seed uses the same GPU model/environment but not necessarily the same node; no bitwise training reproducibility claim.
CE VCS and BCE have weight10; DKD VCS/cosine use10 and BCE uses1, selected by the same short pilot. DKD comparison is between frozen selected recipes, not solely the objective at equal weight.
Cosine uses positive matching only; VCS/BCE use the same off-diagonal cross-instance reference. This comparison cannot attribute the gap solely to the reference term.
No free tanh critic or inner fitting in this decision-coordinate recipe; optimizing those cannot be assumed to resolve this result.
conclusions_cn: 完整长验证未建立VCS独有收益。CE下依赖/匹配辅助项均有益，但VCS弱于余弦，与BCE接近；DKD下VCS三个seed均弱于anchor和两个辅助对照。
固定240轮与末10轮同向；最佳点也没有改变均值结论。原实用增益判据两个anchor均未通过。
长训练是必要的验证：早期排名可反转；但240轮后当前接法没有翻盘，不支持继续以训练不足为由追加预算。
不否定理论本身；结论限于该教师/学生、CIFAR100划分、中心化归一化logits、固定λ与训练配方。

decisions.kd_recipe: Lower priority; no automatic longer training or lambda grid.
decisions.current_queue: Continue registered dense registration and retrieval/NCR series through the sole existing pool.
decisions.registration: Wait for matched dense48 task/curve/cost results; objective microbenchmark alone is insufficient for longer training.
decisions.retrieval: Finish protected three-arm40epoch comparison and original A3/NCR; apply frozen gates only after completeness.
decisions.future_kd: Require a new task-specific hypothesis with matched controls and a frozen finite budget before any new batch; no generic saturation or critic-width explanation is established here.
